topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't help but think about all the times we've walked the same paths, shared countless days and nights, thinking nothing could ever truly separate us. Now, the weight of this news settles in, making the air around me feel heavier. The idea of those empty spaces where laughter once echoed seems more than just a change; it feels like an end. Maybe this is part of life, but that doesn't make it any easier to accept. I find myself looking at the familiar, wondering how I’ll carry on when a piece of this place, a piece of us, is taken away.
